TaskDescription: Visual working memory task performed during clinical SEEG monitoring. The Figshare record refers to 'the accompanying research article' for the paradigm; no event or behavioural files are part of the source (see README).
iEEGReference: Online reference: a white matter site selected by the clinical team (Figshare record).
iEEGPlacementScheme: Multi-contact depth electrodes (8-16 contacts; contact length 2 mm, diameter 0.8 mm, spacing 1.5 mm) implanted stereotactically with robotic assistance; placement determined solely by clinical requirements (Figshare record).
